units.source_text: 这第四十六天的自由，被激烈的狂风吹拂着。

en.t: This freedom on the forty-sixth day was being lashed by a violent gale.

units.source_text: 他趴下来，闪闪发光的沙子撞击着脸、头颈。

en.t: He lay face down, while glittering sand struck his face, head, and neck.

units.source_text: 这样剧烈的风，可没有计算进去哇！……

en.t: He had not counted on a wind this fierce at all! ...

units.source_text: 在洞穴里，一般人只能感觉到海鸣的声音更加靠近了，

en.t: Inside the hole, an ordinary person could only feel that the sound of the sea had drawn closer,

units.source_text: 要在平时，现在正是风平浪静的时刻。

en.t: Normally, this would be just the time when the wind and waves were calm.

units.source_text: 可眼下，似乎无法期待薄雾了。

en.t: But for now, it seemed there was no hope of mist.

units.source_text: 原来天空的浑浊，难道只是洞穴内侧的现象吗？

en.t: Could the murkiness of the sky have been only a phenomenon inside the hole after all?

units.source_text: 难道是把飞沙的流动与薄雾搞混淆了吗？

en.t: Had he mistaken the flow of flying sand for thin mist?

units.source_text: 反正事情变得有些棘手了。

en.t: In any case, things had become rather troublesome.
